name: Ha Long mantis shrimp noodles
summary: Bún bề bề is a morning bowl of three to five mantis shrimp in a broth of the shrimp, prawn, crab, and swimming crab. The shrimp is firm, fragrant, and sweet, and the broth is clean rather than fishy.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls it common across Quảng Ninh and especially in the city.
taste: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls the meat firm, fragrant, and sweet, and the broth clean and sweet, not fishy.
howToEat: The shrimp are peeled so the meat stays in one piece. A bowl has three to five, lined up, plus tôm, cá, fried tofu, and herbs.
The broth is the boiling liquid from the bề bề and from tôm, cua, and ghẹ. The 13 Mar 2019 account calls it clean and sweet, not fishy.
Morning and midday, at local markets, the seafood markets along the Hạ Long shore, and the resort areas such as Bãi Cháy. That article gives about 30,000–40,000 đồng a bowl.
where: Local markets, the shore seafood markets, and Bãi Cháy. Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the bowl had been in the city for under ten years at that writing.
seoTitle: Bun be be Ha Long — morning mantis shrimp noodles
seoDescription: Bún bề bề is a morning bowl of three to five firm, sweet mantis shrimp in a clean seafood broth.
